model_meta.description: Conceptual system model of a bearing assembly with separately functioning spherical sliding tilt support and rolling-bearing rotation mechanism.

subsystems.description: Main body with a spherically shaped mounting hole including a concave portion that receives and retains the sliding member's protrusion.

Self-lubricating sliding member and spherical part; spherical part slides within the member to allow shaft-center tilt. Member protrusion mates with the main body's concave portion. The sliding structure is non-lubricated; shaft-center tilt is a supported capability, not a modeled external flow.

parts.description: Self-lubricating sliding member with protruding portion

subsystems.description: Two rolling bearings, each having inner and outer races, are fitted by their outer races into the spherical part's through hole. A sealed structure is an optional claimed configuration (claims 2 and 4). The mechanism supports shaft rotation, including the described high-speed and continuous rotation capability; external shaft interfaces are not specified.

steps.description: Spherical part slides within the self-lubricating sliding member to permit shaft-center tilt.
Rolling bearings provide the rotary mechanism; the patent describes high-speed and continuous rotation, including when shaft center is tilted.
